alt: What embassies check first in a visa application from the UAE

slides.headline: THREE CHECKS HAPPEN BEFORE ANYONE READS YOUR LETTER.
slides.note: Officers are not reading documents in isolation. They are checking whether the set agrees with itself.

slides.headline: THREE, IN ORDER
items: Does the financial story add up — salary, spending, savings, consistency
Are there real ties to the UAE — employment, residence, family, obligations
Does the itinerary's logic match the documents — dates, cities, bookings

slides.body: Your statement should support your itinerary. Your itinerary should match your reservations. Your letter should explain both.
slides.note: Consistency is unglamorous, and it decides more outcomes than anything else.

slides.headline: WHAT APPLICANTS FOCUS ON INSTEAD
slides.never: Spend all the effort on the balance in the account and none on whether the documents agree. A strong balance inside a contradictory file still reads as a risk.
slides.instead: Run the same three checks the officer will run, before submission, and fix whatever fails them.

slides.headline: WE AUDIT BEFORE THEY DO.
slides.sub: Better we find it than they do.

slides.headline: SEND ONE MESSAGE. WE DO THE REST.
